how: GET https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies with filter.advanced=QUERY, countTotal=true, pageSize=1, fields=NCTId; one request each, 1.5 s apart

every form together.query: AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND (AREA[InterventionName]"crizotinib" OR AREA[InterventionName]"alectinib") AND (AREA[ConditionMeshTerm]"Lung Neoplasms" OR AREA[ConditionAncestorTerm]"Lung Neoplasms") AND (AREA[Phase]PHASE2 OR AREA[Phase]PHASE3) AND (AREA[OverallStatus]RECRUITING OR AREA[OverallStatus]COMPLETED)

unknown status value.error: Error parsing query in advanced filter: Allowed values for enum field `protocolSection.statusModule.overallStatus` are `ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING`, `COMPLETED`, `ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION`, `NOT_YET_RECRUITING`, `RECRUITING`, `SUSPENDED`, `TERMINATED`, `WITHDRAWN`, `AVAILABLE`, `NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE`, `TEMPORARILY_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `APPROVED_FOR_MARKETING`, `WITHHELD`, `UNKNOWN`

the descriptor as ancestor only.note: an ancestor is never the trial's own MeSH term, so the descriptor alone misses the trials tagged with it

the URL length the registry answers.how: a filter.advanced of N quoted InterventionName terms, bisected on N; the length is the whole URL httpx sent
